title: Tarot Readings For 3 Zodiac Signs On The Cusp Of Finding True Love
text:
Tarot Readings For 3 Zodiac Signs On The Cusp Of Finding True Love
By Jamie Toth
Our tarot reader sees that three zodiac signs, Leo, Virgo, Capricorn, are on the verge of true love’s arrival in April.
Below are full tarot readings to help support them during this exciting time!
The cards pulled represent:
- Your Past: Your recent past.
- Working For You: What’s working for you in the present.
- Working Against You: What’s working against you in the present.
- Your Subconscious: What underlying motivations, thoughts, or emotions may be driving your experience.
- Your Goals and Thoughts: What your thoughts gravitate towards, what your goals are, what you’re visualizing and imagining.
- Coming Soon: An event or experience in your not-too-distant Future.
- Advice: A Piece of advice on how to deal with the situation you’re facing.
Leo
Your Past: Knight of Swords, Reversed. You used to be driven,by your love and passion for someone, obsessed by the details and relentlessly moving forward. Your pursuit and maintenance of love with them was such a part of you it became your identity, until you became disillusioned by seeing some inner truths. That pain has echoed through your heart since.
Working For You: Ace of Wands. One of the ways you’ve been moving on from that experience is by throwing yourself into new projects. You’ve been struck by inspiration from an unlikely source, and it’s helping you to lean into the parts of yourself you cherish the most.
Working Against You: Eight of Cups. It’s really hard to walk away, especially if we don’t feel we had the chance to achieve closure, and you’re still holding on to some of the pain from that Knight of Swords. . Take a few steps back and see if you can recognize some old patterns that you initially used to soothe yourself thatt are now working against you.
Your Subconscious: The Empress. The Ace of Wands working in tandem with the fertile Empress in your subconscious means you’ve got periods of intense focus and inspiration, and you know exactly how to use them. You’re wholly devoted to bringing forth something special, and for following your creative endeavors, especially after the disappointment and challenges that you experienced in the Knight of Swords.
Your Goals and Thoughts: Three of Cups. Ideally, you’d like the type of love that can be celebratory, and has as much friendship and camaraderie as possible, and you may be experiencing an intuitive idea that your true love is already among your friends.
Coming Soon: Nine of Pentacles. One of the lessons you’ve learned about yourself in love is to cultivate your own inner garden. Instead of allowing it to dictate your identity and determine your every crusade, allow space within your love for your true self.
Advice: The Chariot, Reversed. Remember that all of these moments are part of your life’s journey, and that sometimes in learning more about ourselves, it can reframe our world and make us rethink our purpose.
Virgo
Your Past: Two of Wands. It recently felt as if you had the whole world stretched out before you, but you weren’t quite ready to embrace it. Allowing yourself to be vulnerable enough to love fully can be overwhelming and scary.
Working For You: The World. You are certainly not hesitant now, and you’ve learned how to make yourself open to and vulnerable enough for love. There’s an abundance of love around you!
Working Against You: The Hermit. One of your challenges is your need for alone time. It’s not that you are doing anything that would put the relationship in jeopardy, it’s that you need time to fully process what you have experience and how it makes you feel, and that requires silence and stillness. Instead of keeping this need to yourself and sneaking away, communicate this need to those you are bringing into your love life, you may find them more understanding and empathetic to that need than you thought!
Your Subconscious: Page of Cups. It should be no surprise that in matters of the heart, you find yourself being drawn towards your more emotional and intuitive side. You feel open and ready for a relationship, especially one that would challenge you to be vulnerable with someone else, and allow yourself to learn from them.
Your Goals and Thoughts: Four of Swords, Reversed. Your thoughts have been racing, and while meditation would help you to sink into and understand your feelings more, you may find yourself challenged to even get a few minutes for contemplation. Remember that you need time to process. Give yourself that time and space now, before mental and emotional burnout complicate things.
Coming Soon: Seven of Wands. You will have learned so much from your experiences, especially about yourself. You understand your worth, and are not likely to completely lose your identity or individuality (like you may be fearing). There are grounded ways to be head over heels in love, and you are one of the ones able to make that happen.
Advice: Ten of Swords, Reversed. Don’t doubt yourself or your capabilities to love.
Capricorn
Your Past: Eight of Pentacles. You’ve been hard at work – on yourself, and the skills that you know you need in order to create a grounded, loving home. Of all the signs, it seems so fitting that you should be so engaged in doing the work and labor of love, and being able to identify how love is an active verb, and not just a passive feeling that happens to you.
Working For You: Five of Wands. You’ve learned a lot from strife and stress that has come before. Instead of taking things personally or as seeing every moment as a competition for who is ‘doing the best,’ you understand how every moment is a way for you to build on the prior lessons in the relationship. Instead of seeing every argument as a way to win, you both are able to see it as a way to explore how you could work best together.
Working Against You: King of Wands. The fact you’ve learned a lot from your past has started to tilt towards arrogance. Don’t assume that you know what your partner is feeling, and don’t assume that you know how the situation is going to play out.
Your Subconscious: Death. Subconsciously, you know that things change, and that to embrace something new will require you to let go of something as well. This is an opportunity to only carry the things that serve you. Let go of behaviors and stories that no longer serve you, and make space in your life and your heart for the new to flourish.
Your Goals and Thoughts: Ace of Cups. The new feelings and new experiences that true love brings to you are all you can think about. They’ve opened your heart, created an endless well of compassion and have created an abundance of love. It’s natural your thoughts want to linger on those positive feelings.
Coming Soon: Two of Wands, Reversed. It’s unexpected, the way that life turns sometimes. Challenges, obstacles, and restrictions are often transformed into opportunities and possibilities for triumph. The presence of true love not only changes you, but the world around you.
Advice: Six of Cups, Reversed. Don’t cling to the past. You’ve grown and are allowed to move on.
